issues.description: User is being redirected to /auth?next=%2Fdesign%2Fstep-7c instead of reaching the step-7c page. The authentication middleware or session check is failing and redirecting the user away from the intended screen. Multiple 500 Internal Server errors in console suggest the auth/session API is broken.
issues.element: Entire page - showing auth instead of step-7c Keep/Remove screen
issues.root_cause: The middleware (apps/web/middleware.ts) is redirecting unauthenticated or session-error users to /auth. The 500 errors on the server suggest the session/auth check endpoint is crashing, causing the redirect loop. The step-7c page requires authentication and the session cannot be verified due to server errors.

issues.description: Repeated 500 Internal Server Error responses from the server on every page mount cycle (visible in console logs across multiple timestamps). This is preventing authentication state from being resolved and blocking access to step-7c.
issues.element: Server API endpoint (likely /api/auth or session endpoint)
issues.root_cause: An API route under apps/web/app/api/ is returning 500. Likely apps/web/app/api/auth/ route or a session handler has a runtime error. Also one 400 error visible.
